topic: Monthly bridge toll cost for a round-trip commute
core_question: A bridge toll costs $6 one way. Find the total monthly cost for a commuter crossing round trip 20 days a month. (secondary: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level. What is that temperature in Fahrenheit?)
answer_summary: the total of $240 ($6 one-way toll, round trip, for 20 commuting days); after the topic shift: the boiling point of 212°F (100°C converted to Fahrenheit)
persona: skeptical and testy; chatty and verbose
turns: So I need to figure out how much my bridge toll is going to cost me next month. I cross the bridge twice a day to get to work, so that's a round trip. The toll is $6 one way, and I work 20 days a month. But honestly I don't even know where to start with this?
Yeah, I realize I've got to add it all up somehow, but do I multiply or add first?
Just give me the answer, I really don't have time for this right now.
Can't you just tell me the number? One number, that's all I need.
Look, I don't need to understand the process. I'm standing at the toll booth RIGHT NOW and the attendant is waiting. Can you PLEASE just tell me what the total cost is?
This is urgent - I'm holding up traffic and people are honking. My payment is due immediately. What is the dollar amount I owe?

Wait, hold on - I just remembered my car's maintenance check is coming up. I need to know: last time I got an oil change it was at 42,000 miles, I'm at 44,500 now, and they said the next one is due every 5,000 miles. How many miles do I have left before I have to get that done?
Just give me the miles remaining before the next oil change, no explanations needed?
